title: Selected physical AC1021 SCALE graph output and readback
scope: Qualify the 17 SCALE records in one existing AC1021 source as a selected rooted ACAD_SCALELIST graph for same-version ASCII and Binary DXF output, typed/raw readback, atomic late-mutation refusal, and same-writer retry.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local drawing. Author and producer are not independently authenticated. No drawing fixture or derivative is committed.

sourceGraph.root: Exactly one ACAD_SCALELIST NOD edge targets the unique AC1021 dictionary; its 17 complete ordered entries each target one typed SCALE with matching parent and unique reactor to the dictionary.
sourceGraph.scaleProfile: Each record has one non-null dictionary owner/reactor, no extension dictionary, appData, extData, data-storage binary data, or common-link tail; names are nonempty and paper/drawing units are finite and positive.
sourceGraph.fields: Flag, name, paper units, drawing units, and isUnitScale are checked against fresh typed and raw DXF readback for each handle.

implementation.profile: The source-bound SCALE snapshot/output path now admits this AC1021 profile alongside the established AC1024 profile and requires same-version output. AC1021 SCALE data causes the NOD-rooted extension graph to be included.
implementation.transaction: A writer subclass mutates one SCALE after OBJECTS serialization. Final snapshot validation refuses both ASCII and Binary output, preserves the existing destination sentinel, and the same writer succeeds after source restoration.

checks: 17 source SCALE identities and all ACAD_SCALELIST dictionary edges are checked before output
ASCII and Binary output imports as 17 typed SCALE records with exact handles, owner/reactor roles, flags, names, numeric fields, unit-scale bits, and raw scalar carriers
Late source mutation after OBJECTS serialization is refused for ASCII and Binary
The pre-existing destination sentinel survives each refusal
Restoring the source allows same-writer retry and fresh readback

ac1024CompatibilityRegression.readbackResult: PASS; the selector first emits its expected injected refusal diagnostic for the atomic-mutation case, then confirms 17 source identities, rooted ACAD_SCALELIST membership, owner/reactors, exact typed/raw fields, destination preservation and retry.

limits: This is one selected graph from one local source; it does not qualify whole-source conversion or another producer/version.
The source author and producer are not independently authenticated, and the route does not establish native scale-list semantics or consumer acceptance.
The broader AC1021 inventory still contains 32 unqualified opaque carriers and 62 unqualified standard-object frames; other graph dependencies and document-wide output remain gated.
nextAction: Continue with another independently bounded physical graph/source family, prioritizing the existing inventory and preserving source, role, dependency, output, and readback gates.
